tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Private-charter routes by departure city (Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary · Banff, Halifax), with lengths and the from-price for Toronto routes.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Instant per-vehicle price range (CAD, tax included) for Toronto routes, airport transfers or a custom route, from the public price book. Read-only: books nothing.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Submits an order for the traveller with their consent. No payment is taken: Shuttlely confirms availability by email, then sends a deposit link. Returns an order number.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Routes from Vancouver, Calgary · Banff and Halifax, or anything custom: sends the request and Shuttlely emails a written per-vehicle price. No payment.
